MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

8. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. D — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
